Maya: Sunspot lottery at the big window bench at 1pm — who wants it? I brought a salad and will trade shade for a seat. :sun_with_face:
Chris: I nominate Pretzel Larry as official bench guardian. Also yes if someone saves a crumb.
Devon: I can take it! Will bring iced tea. :raised_hand:  
Priya: Can we do a 12:45 swap? I have a 1:10 call but want 10 minutes of sunshine first.
Maya: @Priya yep that works — I'll move after 12:55 so you can have the glow for your call.
KitchenBot: FYI leftover salad in fridge labeled 'Maya' (expires 2026-03-24).
Chris: Also who put a tiny rubber duck in my mug? Mystery of the morning continues. :duck:  
Devon: Not me. I saw a suspicious paperclip trail toward the plants zone.
Priya: Vote by reaction: :sunny: = I'll take the bench at 1, :cloud: = pass.
Maya: Starting a quick poll: /poll "Window bench at 1pm" "I'm in" "Pass"
Chris: :sunny:
Devon: :sunny:
Priya: :cloud: I'll take the 12:45 handoff.
Maya: Sweet. Bench reserved for Chris at 1, Devon 12:50-1, Priya 12:45-12:55.
Chris: Photo evidence required. Beam me with full sunny glory later pls. :camera:
Devon: Selfie incoming with iced tea and dramatic squint.
Maya: Also reminder — if you borrow someone's sunglasses, please return them. Last week we nearly started a bidding war over black cat-shaped frames. :sunglasses:
Chris: Noted. Returning forks and sunglasses policy enacted. :thumbsup:
Priya: See y'all at lunch. Might bring cookies.
KitchenBot: Cookie alert acknowledged. Calories unknown.
Maya: Thread closed unless more sun disputes arise. :sun_with_face:
